Study workshop

Tools

A calm workshop for the King James Bible—map, memorize, browse context, and search the text.

Quiet tools to help you understand and teach the KJV. Everything here is built to stay light and fast; open each tool once while online so it is ready when you need it offline.

Verse lookup, topic search, and Ask the Word stay in the Bible Tool. This page is the shelf for maps, memory, book intros, the full word-help index, and concordance. Notes and your queue live in My Study.

Tap any underlined KJV word for a short, plain meaning.

Start here in 30 seconds

Need context Open Verse Maps See the place, then read related verses. Need cross-text Run concordance Pull every verse tied to one word. Need retention Do memory drill Practice one verse until it sticks.

At a glance

  • Verse Maps See a place on the map and read related verses
  • Verse Memory Fill-in-the-blank from today’s chapter
  • Today’s Quiz Quick questions on today’s chapter
  • Book introductions What each book is doing, in plain words
  • KJV word helps Short glosses for older or easy-to-misread words
  • Concordance Find every verse that uses a word

Study & search

Book introductions

Short orientation for each book: what fight it serves, a few anchor verses, and one small step. The same text appears in the chapter reader and in Bible Tool after a lookup—this grid is the place to browse them all. Plan tie-ins live on Battle Plans.

KJV word helps

Short glosses for wording that often misleads modern readers. Tap the headword to search the concordance below; tap a verse to open it in the Bible Tool. After a lookup, the Tool’s study companion can show glosses for words in that verse only—this list is the full A–Z index.
